name: Interior Design
overview: The field of interior design is a dynamic and ever-evolving arena that blends creativity with practicality to enhance the spaces where we live, work, and play. Modern practice combines innovative materials, sustainable practices, and technology like 3D modeling and virtual reality. The profession has evolved from simple room furnishing to encompassing space management, building codes, and the latest design trends.

topJobs.description: Transform houses and apartments into personalized homes through layout, furniture, color schemes, and lighting decisions.
Create functional spaces for businesses while incorporating brand identity and strategic space planning.
Advise on eco-friendly materials, energy efficiency, and green building techniques.
Create captivating displays for museums, galleries, trade shows, and events.

institutesInternational: Royal College of Art, London, UK
Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD), USA
careerLadder: Senior designer roles or project manager positions
